title: ETTP Action
description: A request by an entity to perform an operation against a target with arguments and optional context.

type.description: An extensible action category, such as `TOOL_CALL`.

target.description: The target resource, tool, or operation name for the action.

operation.description: The operation the entity requests to perform.

arguments.description: Operation parameters supplied with the request.

context.description: Optional evaluation context for the requested action.

extensions.description: Optional implementation-defined extension data. Extensions must not redefine ETTP protocol fields.
